skills.name: Unarmed Combat
skills.description: Fists, grapples, and improvised force when no weapon is ready.

skills.name: Armed Combat
skills.description: Class weapon discipline. Renamed per class in the UI.

skills.name: Fieldcraft
skills.description: Endurance on the road. Stretches how long you can press on before you must recover.

skills.name: Toolwright
skills.description: Repair gear, fashion tools, and work raw materials into something useful.

skills.name: Apothecary
skills.description: Bandages, tonics, poisons, and whatever else can be mixed from plant and mineral.

notes: Skills range 0–100. One training point per level. Percent gained per point depends on relevant stats so a single path cannot trivially max every skill.
